mathematicalFindings.finding: All four aggregate admitted local-model slopes g·v/2 remain negative while all four actual finite objective changes are positive. The narratives retain heterogeneous strata, including positive admitted slopes on some padding strata, mapping magnitude loss, small signed admission terms, and the distinction between ideal local slope and the finite BF16 objective.

The scalar supplement derives differences from public scalar records. It does not independently identify curvature, an exact finite derivative, Jacobian error or BF16 causation. The squared-residual identity and its positive quadratic terms explain why negative linear prediction alone is insufficient, without assigning the measured gap to one cause.

For the mean of four squared terms, the retained g omits a common factor and g·v/2 is the declared anchored ideal local-model slope. The full-J ray model is L0 + alpha*(g·q)/2 + alpha^2*beta/4; alpha_model=-(g·q)/beta when applicable.

From AΔ=-g+r, the stated surrogate value L0+(g·Δ)/4+(Δ·r)/4 and the source-qualified residual bound are algebraically consistent. Its inferred negative value is not a measured exact Hessian, numerical replay, capacity null or evidence that the completed execution was invalid.

The proposed B maps changes in all 23 existing constants jointly to rows while retaining parent routes. With positive diagonal leaf mass D, r=-D^-1 B^T g and q=B r give g·q<=0 in exact arithmetic. Curvature uses both state metric and actual ideal-Jacobian image: beta=q^T M_H q+(Jq)^T M_Z(Jq). No large inverse or changed-route zero-dose assumption is introduced.

The one fixed eta=1/16 relative-row trust cap is a construction choice, not a universal guarantee. FP32 atom admission and both BF16 state admissions must remain explicit, and alpha=0 requires exact parent-byte restoration. Actual finite feedback may reject the sole proposed candidate; rejected evidence remains retained.

Fixed routes cannot distinguish histories/rows with identical owned H0 and the same two leaf selections. The plan does not claim to repair the known vessel-padding collision, expand atoms/features/routes, prove own-state closure, or produce general pixels.
